settings.question: How much is delivery?
settings.answer: UK delivery is free on orders over £75. Delivery costs for other orders and countries are shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes. Choose your country in the footer to see where we ship and what it costs.

settings.question: How long will my order take?
settings.answer: Estimated delivery times for your address are shown at checkout. You’ll get a dispatch email with tracking once your order is on its way.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships you’ll get an email with a tracking link. You can also use Track your order and we’ll look into it for you.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: If your order hasn’t shipped yet we can usually change it. Send us a message as soon as you can with your order number.

settings.question: How do I return something?
settings.answer: Returns are accepted within 30 days. Unworn items in their original condition can be sent back. Start on our Return a product page with your email and order number.

settings.question: When will I get my refund?
settings.answer: Refunds go back to your original payment method once we’ve received and checked your return.

settings.question: What does the warranty cover?
settings.answer: Our gear is covered against faults in materials and workmanship. It doesn’t cover normal wear and tear, or damage from misuse.

settings.question: How do I make a warranty claim?
settings.answer: Use our Request a warranty page with your order number and a description of the problem.

settings.question: How do I contact you?
settings.answer: You can send us a message or find other ways to reach us on our Contact us page.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout, including major credit and debit cards.

settings.question: Is my payment secure?
settings.answer: Yes. Payments are processed securely at checkout and we never see or store your full card details.

settings.question: How do your sizes fit?
settings.answer: Each product page has a size guide. If you’re between sizes, we’d suggest sizing up for a looser fit on the run.

settings.question: How should I wash my gear?
settings.answer: Wash cold with similar colours, avoid fabric softener and tumble dry on low or hang to dry. Full care details are on each product page.

settings.title: Send us a message
settings.text: Our team will get back to you shortly with answers about our products and orders.

settings.title: Contact us by email
settings.text: Prefer email? Write to us any time and we’ll reply within one working day.
